Verdict: accumulate  
Risk: medium

Rationale: FY2025 XBRL shows strong OCF and FCF above dividends, aligning with dividend/FCF screens, but E&P cyclicality, leverage and Yahoo FCF (−$703m) vs filing OCF−capex temper the strong-buy case.  
RiskTags: cyclical, leverage

- [filings/bodies/6da99cf3c8b75d6a.txt] "No ceiling test impairment was recorded for the three months ended September 30, 2026." — No quarterly ceiling-test write-down as of Q3 2026, though commodity sensitivity remains.

- [filings/bodies/6da99cf3c8b75d6a.txt] "indebtedness and restrictions to our operating and financial flexibility; • changes in our credit rating; • failure to identify, complete and successfully integrate acquisitions, including Viper’s McE" — Leverage and acquisition-integration risks flagged in interim risk factors.

- [filings/bodies/6da99cf3c8b75d6a.txt] "uncertainties over our future dividends and share repurchases;" — Management explicitly flags uncertainty around capital returns.

- [filings/bodies/6da99cf3c8b75d6a.txt] "Impairment of oil and natural gas properties 1,400 —" — Nine months ended 30 Sep 2026 included $1.4bn property impairment in the cash-flow reconciliation.

- [filings/bodies/e026418c5b6907bc.txt] "commodity prices, the Company exposes itself to credit risk and market risk." — Commodity-price exposure drives earnings and cash-flow volatility.

THESIS BREAKS

- Filed annual OCF minus PP&E capex falls below cash dividends for two consecutive years while the base dividend is maintained or raised.

- Quarterly SEC ceiling-test or property impairments at a scale that routinely absorbs operating cash flow (as in FY2024 statutory FCF deficit).

- A disclosed increase in funded indebtedness or covenant constraints that materially limits drilling, hedging or shareholder returns, per risk-factor language.

- A cut or suspension of the base dividend despite the board’s stated $4.20 annual base increase pathway.
